title: Attitude Adverbs: 到底, 简直, 反正, 毕竟, 难道, 恐怕, 千万, 尽量, 干脆
description: On earth, simply, anyway, after all, surely not?, I'm afraid, be sure to, as much as possible, and 'just (do it)'.

points.title: 到底: on earth, exactly
points.summary: In questions, 到底 (dàodǐ) pushes for a clear answer: 你到底去不去?

points.title: 简直: simply, practically
points.body: - 这道题太难了，**简直**不可能做出来.

points.title: 反正: anyway, in any case
points.summary: 反正 (fǎnzhèng) = whatever happens / it doesn't matter, because ….
points.body: - 你别着急，**反正**还有时间.
examples: {去|qù}{不|bu}{去|qù}{都|dōu}{可以|kěyǐ}，{反正|fǎnzhèng}{我|wǒ}{明天|míngtiān}{没|méi}{事|shì}。
Going or not is fine — I'm free tomorrow anyway.

points.title: 毕竟: after all
points.summary: 毕竟 (bìjìng) = after all (reminding of an important fact).
points.body: - 别生他的气，他**毕竟**还是个孩子.
examples: {毕竟|bìjìng}{是|shì}{第一|dì-yī}{次|cì}，{做|zuò}{得|de}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{正常|zhèngcháng}。
It's the first time, after all — it's normal not to do it well.

points.title: 难道 …?: surely not …?
points.summary: 难道 (nándào) makes a rhetorical question: 'don't tell me …?!'.

points.title: 恐怕: I'm afraid (that)
points.summary: 恐怕 (kǒngpà) softens bad news or a worried guess.
examples: {天|tiān}{这么|zhème}{黑|hēi}，{恐怕|kǒngpà}{要|yào}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}。
It's so dark — I'm afraid it's going to rain.

points.title: 千万 + 要 / 别: be sure to / whatever you do, don't
points.summary: 千万 (qiānwàn) strengthens advice and warnings.
points.body:
- 路上很滑，你**千万**要小心!
- 你**千万**别忘了!

points.title: 尽量: as much as possible
points.summary: 尽量 (jǐnliàng) + verb = do your best to ….
examples: Please use as few plastic bags as possible.

points.title: 干脆: just (decisively)
points.summary: 干脆 (gāncuì) + verb = cut it short and just do ….
points.body: - 修了好几次还是坏，**干脆**买个新的吧.
examples: {没有|méiyǒu}{车|chē}{了|le}，{我们|wǒmen}{干脆|gāncuì}{走|zǒu}{回去|huíqù}{吧|ba}。
There are no buses left — let's just walk back.

notes: 毕竟 = 'after all' — not in questions.
questions.translation: Are you going or not? Make up your mind!

notes: 到底 goes before the verb phrase.
No 吗 — and 到底 goes before 想.
No 吗 with a question word.
questions.translation: What on earth do you want?

questions.prompt: {这|zhè}{道|dào}{题|tí}{太|tài}{难|nán}{了|le}，（　）{不|bù}{可能|kěnéng}{做|zuò}{出来|chūlái}。
questions.translation: This question is so hard it's practically impossible to solve.

questions.prompt: What does 「{他|tā}{简直|jiǎnzhí}{像|xiàng}{个|ge}{孩子|háizi}。」 mean?

questions.translation: Don't rush — there's still time anyway.
Going or not is fine — I'm free tomorrow anyway.

questions.prompt: {别|bié}{生|shēng}{他|tā}{的|de}{气|qì}{了|le}，{他|tā}（　）{还|hái}{是|shì}{个|ge}{孩子|háizi}。
notes: 难道 makes a rhetorical question.
简直还是个孩子 isn't natural.
questions.translation: Don't be angry with him — he's only a child, after all.

questions.prompt: What does 「{毕竟|bìjìng}{是|shì}{第一|dì-yī}{次|cì}，{做|zuò}{得|de}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{正常|zhèngcháng}。」 mean?
notes: 做得不好 = not done well.

questions.translation: Don't tell me you don't know there's an exam tomorrow?!
It's so dark — I'm afraid it's going to rain.

questions.prompt: What does 「{恐怕|kǒngpà}{他|tā}{今天|jīntiān}{来|lái}{不|bu}{了|liǎo}{了|le}。」 mean?
notes: 恐怕 softens — it isn't certain.
恐怕 is the speaker's worry, not his fear.

questions.translation: The roads are slippery — be really careful!

notes: 千万 is for advice to others.
questions.translation: Don't worry, I'll try to come as early as I can.

questions.prompt: What does 「{请|qǐng}{尽量|jǐnliàng}{少|shǎo}{用|yòng}{塑料袋|sùliàodài}。」 mean?
notes: 尽量 isn't a total ban.

questions.prompt: {这么|zhème}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}，{没有|méiyǒu}{车|chē}{了|le}，{我们|wǒmen}（　）{走|zǒu}{回去|huíqù}{吧|ba}。
questions.translation: It's so late and there are no buses — let's just walk back.

questions.prompt: {这|zhè}{台|tái}{电脑|diànnǎo}{修|xiū}{了|le}{好几|hǎo jǐ}{次|cì}{还是|háishi}{坏|huài}，（　）{买|mǎi}{个|ge}{新|xīn}{的|de}{吧|ba}。
notes: 难道 makes a rhetorical question.
questions.translation: This computer has been repaired several times and still breaks — let's just buy a new one.
